clauses.clause: Opus answers three questions per level: glitches (list), stunning (verdict + missing), **boring / harmless / babysitting** (list). Any "harmless" or "babysitting" finding blocks GO.
clauses.note: Fresh low-tier review answers all3 questions for every level in README and the92-image original-resolution manifest. Blocking L7 babysitting: Aboard21/24 remains unchanged from tick5640 through7560 (32s); empty controls, no story lock, no entering passenger. Target62 remains~2m from the bus. Last28s have0 live infected; assisted recovery appears at7680 and all24 board at7800. Reviewed current bus frames at ticks6000/7200 show the stalled nearby figures. Repro: SCENE_PORT=4834 BROWSER_POOL_JOB_ID=rr-b node --import tsx/esm test-results/rr-b/g27-boarding.mjs 7 7; seed1 low default complete bot; inspect boardingStatus and boarded count. L1 upper-bound waiting and protected zero damage are explicitly excluded as failure evidence. L10 partial-route timeouts and late Resume scope are disclosed.
